statement: You are given an integer array nums. Sort it into non-decreasing order with bubble sort.

Each pass walks over the unsorted part, comparing neighbouring elements and swapping any pair that is out of order. This carries the largest remaining value to the end of that part. If a pass makes no swap, the array is already sorted and the algorithm stops early.

examples.explanation: Three passes settle 9, 8 and 5 at the end. The fourth pass makes no swap, so the sort stops there.
The input is in reverse order, so every comparison causes a swap until the array is sorted.
